title: Trump’s Treasured Negotiating Edge Dulled By Tariff Defeat

title: World Leaders Scope Out US’s Next Steps After Tariff Ruling
summary: Governments around the world reacted with caution after the US Supreme Court invalidated President Donald Trump’s broad emergency tariffs, with some reaffirming existing agreements and others taking a wait-and-see approach to evaluate his next steps.
